about: BIG Shopping Centers Ltd engages in engaged in development, construction, rental, and operation of offices and rental housing properties in Israel, Czechia, Poland, Romania, and internationally. The company operates various projects in retail, logistics, offices, and residences for rent, as well as investing in renewable energy projects. It is also involved in the construction, development, acquisition, and holding of malls under the Big Fashion brand name, as well as mixed-use assets, including offices, residences, hotels, senior housing, and medical facilities.
